name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
short_description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
detailed_description: Under the PM-KISAN scheme, operational since December 2018, all landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names are provided financial assistance of Rs. 6,000 per year, payable in three installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months directly into their Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
description_kannada: ದೇಶದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕೃಷಿ ಭೂಮಿ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ರೈತ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ರೂ. 6,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಸಮಾನ ಕಂತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Occupation must be Farmer
rules.source_citation: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, Section 2.1 (Definition of Farmer Family)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you engaged in agricultural farming as your primary occupation?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮುಖ್ಯ ವೃತ್ತಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಅಥವಾ ಕೃಷಿ ಕೆಲಸವೇ?

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: Rs. 6,000 annual direct benefit transfer in 3 installments of Rs. 2,000 each.
required_documents: Land ownership records / RoR (Record of Rights / Pahani)
Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar
application_process: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click on 'Farmers Corner' -> 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar number and select state/district.
Fill in landholding survey numbers and bank account details.
Submit the application and complete eKYC via OTP or biometric authentication.
source_title: PM-KISAN Official Portal, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
source_excerpt: The Scheme aims to provide income support to all landholder farmer families across the country with cultivable land, subject to certain exclusion criteria relating to higher income brackets.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_kannada: ಆಯುಷ್ಮಾನ್ ಭಾರತ್ - ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಜನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
short_description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
detailed_description: PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme aimed at providing a health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) that form the bottom 40% of the Indian population.
description_kannada: ಬಡ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ರೂ. 5 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ನಗದು ರಹಿತ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Family Annual Income Limit
rules.source_citation: AB-PMJAY Guidelines, Deprivation Criteria based on SECC 2011 / State NFSA lists
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your approximate total annual family income in rupees?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಒಟ್ಟು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ಎಷ್ಟು?

benefits_summary: Cashless treatment and secondary/tertiary hospitalization cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year.
application_process: Visit the official portal at pmjay.gov.in or beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
Enter your mobile number and authenticate via OTP to check SECC eligibility.
Verify your family details using Ration Card or Aadhaar number.
Visit any empaneled public or private hospital with your Ayushman Card for cashless admission.
source_title: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source_excerpt: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides cashless access to healthcare services for the beneficiary at the point of service, that is, the hospital.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
short_description: Financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month to the woman head of household in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Gruha Lakshmi is one of the flagship guarantee schemes of the Government of Karnataka, providing monthly financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 directly transferred to the bank account of the woman designated as head of the family on Antyodaya, BPL, and APL ration cards.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್/ಎಪಿಎಲ್ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಯಜಮಾನಿ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾದ ಮಹಿಳೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ರೂ. 2,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Govt of Karnataka Order No. WCD 129 MPS 2023, Dated 05-06-2023
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a permanent resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Must be Female Head of Family
rules.source_citation: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme Rules, Section 3 (Eligibility of Female Head)
rules.clarification_question_en: Is the applicant the female head of the household?

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is the age of the female applicant?

benefits_summary: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 2,000 every month into the Aadhaar-linked bank account.
required_documents: Ration Card with woman specified as Head of Family
Aadhaar Card of the applicant woman
Bank passbook with Aadhaar-seeded NPCI mapping
application_process: Visit the nearest Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centre, or apply on Seva Sindhu portal.
Provide Ration Card number and Aadhaar details.
Complete biometric or OTP verification.
Receive SMS confirmation with application acknowledgement number.
source_title: Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal, Government of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month is provided to women heads of families in Karnataka who hold Antyodaya, BPL, or APL cards, excluding income tax payees.

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Govt of Karnataka
short_description: Unemployment allowance of Rs. 3,000/month for degree holders and Rs. 1,500/month for diploma holders in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Yuva Nidhi provides financial support to graduates and diploma holders from Karnataka who remain unemployed 6 months after graduation, for a maximum period of 2 years or until employment is secured, alongside skill development training.
description_kannada: ಪದವಿ ಪಡೆದು 6 ತಿಂಗಳಾದರೂ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ದೊರೆಯದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಯುವಕರಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ ರೂ. 3,000 ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಪ್ಲೋಮಾ ಹೊಂದಿದವರಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ ರೂ. 1,500 ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗ ಭತ್ಯೆ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Notification, SDEL Dept, 2023
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Must be Unemployed
rules.source_citation: Yuva Nidhi Guidelines Section 4 (Self-Declaration of Unemployment)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you currently unemployed and seeking employment?

rules.name: Degree or Diploma Graduate
rules.source_citation: Yuva Nidhi Eligibility Criteria, Clause 2 (Educational Qualification)
rules.clarification_question_en: Have you completed a degree or diploma program?

benefits_summary: Rs. 3,000/month for degree holders and Rs. 1,500/month for diploma holders for up to 2 years.
required_documents: Degree or Diploma Marks Cards / Passing Certificate
Karnataka Domicile / Study Certificate proving 6 years study in Karnataka
Bank passbook linked with Aadhaar and mobile
application_process: Register on Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in).
Select 'Yuva Nidhi Scheme' application.
Enter University / Board registration number to fetch degree details.
Submit self-declaration of unemployment and verify with Aadhaar OTP.
source_title: Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Dept, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Yuva Nidhi offers financial support of Rs. 3000 to degree graduates and Rs. 1500 to diploma holders who passed out in the academic year 2022-23 and remained unemployed for 6 months.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
name_kannada: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ (SC) ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೆಟ್ರಿಕ್ ನಂತರದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of India
short_description: Complete tuition fee waiver and monthly maintenance allowance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation courses.
detailed_description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their higher education, covering all non-refundable compulsory fees and monthly maintenance allowances.
description_kannada: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಎಸ್.ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್.ಸಿ ನಂತರದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಸಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಭತ್ಯೆ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.

rules.name: Social Category must be SC
rules.source_citation: Post Matric Scholarship SC Guidelines 2020-21 to 2025-26, Section 3.1
rules.clarification_question_en: Do you belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 2.5 Lakh
rules.source_citation: Post Matric Scholarship SC Guidelines, Section 4 (Means Test)
rules.description_kannada: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 2.50 ಲಕ್ಷ ಮೀರಬಾರದು
rules.clarification_question_en: Is your total family annual income below or up to Rs. 2,50,000?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 2,50,000 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದೆಯೇ?

rules.name: Must be an active student
rules.source_citation: Post Matric Scholarship SC Guidelines, Section 3 (Eligibility)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you currently enrolled as a full-time or part-time student?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಅಥವಾ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ?

benefits_summary: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed + monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs. 1,200/month.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by authorized revenue authority (Tahsildar)
Income Certificate (valid within ceiling of Rs. 2.5 Lakh)
SSLC Marks card / Previous qualifying exam marks sheet
Aadhaar card linked with active bank account
application_process: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or Karnataka SSP (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
Complete student e-KYC using Aadhaar and mobile OTP.
Enter college admission details, college code, and course name.
Upload verified caste and income certificate RD numbers.
Submit and submit printout to the college nodal officer for verification.
source_title: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
source_excerpt: Scholarships are paid to students whose parents/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- per annum.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
short_description: Collateral-free institutional business loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh (extended to Rs. 20 Lakh) for micro and small enterprises.
detailed_description: PMMY provides loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh (and up to Rs. 20 Lakh under Tarun Plus category) to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Classified into three categories: Shishu (loans up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (loans Rs. 50,001 to Rs. 5 Lakh), and Tarun (loans Rs. 5 Lakh to Rs. 10 Lakh).
description_kannada: ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಸ್ಥರು, ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಯಂ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಅಡಮಾನವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ರೂ. 50,000 ದಿಂದ ರೂ. 10 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: Collateral-free loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh with affordable interest rates and Mudra RuPay card.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Business registration / enterprise quotation / project report
Bank statement for the last 6 months
application_process: Apply online through the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank, RRB, or MFI.
Select appropriate loan category: Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun.
Submit business proposal and identity documents.
Loan is processed and sanctioned without requiring collateral security.
source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd (MUDRA), Govt of India
source_excerpt: Under the aegis of PMMY, MUDRA has created products for funding micro enterprises at various stages of growth.

name: Shakti Scheme (Karnataka)
department: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
short_description: Free bus travel for all women residents of Karnataka across state-run RTC ordinary and express buses.
detailed_description: The Shakti scheme offers free travel for women, girls, and transgender persons who are permanent residents of Karnataka in non-luxury buses operated by KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC across Karnataka state.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು, ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿನಿಯರು ಮತ್ತು ತೃತೀಯಲಿಂಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೆ.ಎಸ್.ಆರ್.ಟಿ.ಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿ.ಎಂ.ಟಿ.ಸಿ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಬಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Govt Order No. TD 43 SL 2023, Bengaluru, dated 05-06-2023
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Female or Transgender
rules.source_citation: Govt Order No. TD 43 SL 2023, Clause 2 (Eligible Beneficiaries)
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your gender?

benefits_summary: 100% free bus fare across all non-AC state transport buses in Karnataka.
required_documents: Any Govt-issued photo ID showing Karnataka address (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence)
application_process: Present a government-issued address proof to the bus conductor inside any eligible state transport bus to receive a zero-fare ticket.
source_title: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Free travel is permitted to all women domiciled in Karnataka in KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC ordinary and express buses.

name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Karnataka)
department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka
short_description: Free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month for all residential households in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Gruha Jyothi provides zero-electricity bills up to 200 units of monthly domestic electricity consumption to all household consumers in Karnataka whose average consumption is within their eligible entitlement limit.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮನೆ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ 200 ಯೂನಿಟ್‌ಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Govt Order No. EN 22 PSR 2023, Energy Dept, Govt of Karnataka
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you living in a household in Karnataka?

benefits_summary: Zero electricity charge for domestic consumption up to 200 units/month.
required_documents: Electricity Account ID / Connection Consumer Number (from BESCOM/MESCOM/HESCOM/GESCOM/CESC)
application_process: Visit Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in/gruhajyothi).
Enter your electricity ESCOM name and Consumer Account ID.
Verify Aadhaar with OTP.
Select whether applicant is Owner or Tenant and submit.
source_title: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka
source_excerpt: The Gruha Jyothi scheme provides up to 200 units of free power to all domestic electricity consumers in the state of Karnataka.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
name_kannada: ಪಿಎಂ ಸ್ವನಿಧಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಬೀದಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳ ಆತ್ಮನಿರ್ಭರ ನಿಧಿ)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Govt of India
short_description: Affordable collateral-free working capital loan starting from Rs. 10,000 up to Rs. 50,000 for street vendors.
detailed_description: PM SVANidhi provides working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors to resume livelihoods. Offers first tranche loan up to Rs. 10,000, second tranche up to Rs. 20,000 on prompt repayment, and third tranche up to Rs. 50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.
description_kannada: ನಗರ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಬೀದಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ತಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಲು ಯಾವುದೇ ಭದ್ರತೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ರೂ. 10,000 ದಿಂದ 50,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿದರದ ಸಾಲ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Occupation must be Street Vendor
rules.source_citation: PM SVANidhi Scheme Guidelines Section 3.1 (Beneficiary Identification)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a street vendor or hawker engaged in vending goods/services?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು ಬೀದಿ ಬದಿಯ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಅಥವಾ ತಳ್ಳುವ ಗಾಡಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯೇ?

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: Collateral-free working capital loan of Rs. 10,000 / 20,000 / 50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_process: Access the official portal pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.
Verify mobile number with OTP linked to Aadhaar.
Enter Vending ID or ULB Letter of Recommendation.
Choose preferred lending institution and submit.
source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
source_excerpt: A central sector scheme to facilitate street vendors access to affordable working capital loans for resuming their livelihoods.

name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
short_description: Incentive of Rs. 10,000 per hectare directly credited to farmers cultivating minor millets (Siri Dhanya) in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Raitha Siri promotes millet farming by offering financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 2 hectares) to farmers cultivating designated minor millets like Foxtail, Kodo, Little, Barnyard, and Proso millets in Karnataka.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್‌ಗೆ ರೂ. 10,000 ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಧನ ನೀಡುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Karnataka Agriculture Dept Order on Siri Dhanya Incentive
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a farmer cultivating land in Karnataka?

rules.name: Must be Farmer
rules.clarification_question_en: Is farming your primary occupation?

benefits_summary: Financial grant of Rs. 10,000 per hectare up to a ceiling of 2 hectares (max Rs. 20,000).
required_documents: Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System (FRUITS) ID
application_process: Enroll with FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in) through the local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
Declare millet crop sowing in the crop survey mobile app.
Upon inspection by the Agriculture officer, incentive is transferred via DBT.
source_title: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: To encourage the cultivation of minor millets, the State Government provides Rs. 10,000 per hectare direct incentive to registered farmers.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt of India
short_description: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans with skill training, Rs. 15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.
detailed_description: PM Vishwakarma is designed to uplift traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 designated trades (such as carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, cobblers, tailors) with official recognition, stipend of Rs. 500/day during skill training, Rs. 15,000 modern toolkit grant, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs. 3,00,000.
description_kannada: 18 ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕಸುಬುದಾರರು ಮತ್ತು ಕುಶಲಕರ್ಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ತರಬೇತಿ, ರೂ. 15,000 ಟೂಲ್‌ಕಿಟ್ ಅನುದಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಶೇ. 5ರ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ ಬಡ್ಡಿದರದಲ್ಲಿ ರೂ. 3 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗೆ ಆಸ್ತಿರಹಿತ ಸಾಲ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Traditional Artisan / Craftsman
rules.source_citation: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines 2023, Section 3.1 (Eligible Trades)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you engaged in one of the 18 traditional artisan trades (carpenter, potter, tailor, cobbler, blacksmith, etc.)?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು 18 ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕಸುಬುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ (ಬಡಗಿ, ಕುಂಬಾರ, ಕಮ್ಮಾರ, ದರ್ಜಿ, ಅಕ್ಕಸಾಲಿಗ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ) ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ?

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, Rs. 500/day training stipend, Rs. 15,000 toolkit voucher, and collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.
benefits_amount: Rs. 15,000 toolkit + Loan up to Rs. 3 Lakh
required_documents: Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_process: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile.
Biometric authentication and verification of trade details.
Gram Panchayat or ULB verification followed by District Committee approval.
Download PM Vishwakarma digital ID and attend basic skill training.
source_title: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt of India
source_excerpt: To strengthen and nurture traditional artisans and craftspeople, who work with their hands and tools.

name: Karnataka Ganga Kalyana Scheme
department: Karnataka Backward Classes, Social Welfare & Minorities Development Corporations
short_description: Free individual and community borewell drilling with pump energization for small & marginal SC/ST/OBC farmers in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Ganga Kalyana provides agricultural irrigation facilities by drilling open wells or borewells and installing submersible pump sets with electricity connection free of cost for small and marginal farmers belonging to SC, ST, and Backward Classes in Karnataka.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗ, ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪಂಗಡದ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ನೀರಾವರಿಗಾಗಿ ಉಚಿತ ಬೋರ್‌ವೆಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಂಪ್‌ಸೆಟ್ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Occupation must be Farmer
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you an agricultural farmer?

rules.name: Social Category must be SC, ST, OBC, or Minority
rules.description_kannada: ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಯು SC, ST, ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗ ಅಥವಾ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿರಬೇಕು
rules.clarification_question_en: Which social category do you belong to (SC, ST, OBC, Minority, or General)?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದವರು (SC, ST, OBC, ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ)?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 2 Lakh
rules.source_citation: Ganga Kalyana Annual Income Ceiling Notification 2023
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your total annual family income?

benefits_summary: 100% subsidy for borewell drilling, casing pipe, submersible pump set installation, and electrification up to Rs. 4.5 Lakh.
required_documents: Land RTC / Pahani copy showing small/marginal farmer status (1.5 to 5 acres)
application_process: Apply online through Karnataka Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) when notifications open.
Select the relevant Development Corporation (D. Devaraj Urs, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, Valmiki, etc.).
Upload RTC and caste/income documents.
Scrutiny by taluk selection committee headed by MLA.
source_title: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Dept, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Irrigation facility is provided by drilling borewells to agricultural lands owned by small and marginal farmers belonging to SC/ST and backward classes.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
short_description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after 60 years of age for unorganized sector workers.
detailed_description: APY is a government-backed pension scheme targeted at citizens in the unorganized sector. Subscribers contribute periodically between age 18 and 40, and receive a guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 from the age of 60 years until death, with spouse continuation and return of corpus to nominee.
description_kannada: ಅಸಂಘಟಿತ ವಲಯದ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಗೆ 60 ವರ್ಷ ತುಂಬಿದ ನಂತರ ಮಾಸಿಕ ರೂ. 1,000 ದಿಂದ 5,000 ವರೆಗೆ ಖಾತರಿಯ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Age between 18 and 40 years
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age? (Must be between 18 and 40 to enroll in APY)
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಯಸ್ಸು ಎಷ್ಟು? (ಅಟಲ್ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ ಯೋಜನೆಗೆ 18 ರಿಂದ 40 ವರ್ಷದೊಳಗಿರಬೇಕು)

benefits_summary: Guaranteed monthly lifetime pension of Rs. 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000, or 5,000 starting from age 60.
application_process: Visit any bank branch or post office where you hold a savings bank account.
Fill in the APY registration form with auto-debit consent.
PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card is issued.
source_title: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
source_excerpt: Under the APY, a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000/- to Rs. 5,000/- per month will be given at the age of 60 years depending on the contributions by the subscriber.

name: Karnataka Vidyasiri Scheme (Food & Accommodation Stipend)
name_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ವಿದ್ಯಾಸಿರಿ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ಸಹಾಯ)
department: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
short_description: Monthly stipend of Rs. 1,500 for 10 months to backward classes post-matric students who do not secure government hostel admission.
detailed_description: Vidyasiri scheme provides Rs. 1,500 per month for 10 months each academic year (total Rs. 15,000) directly to bank accounts of post-matric OBC/SC/ST/Minority students who live in rented accommodation because government hostels have no available seats.
description_kannada: ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಹಾಸ್ಟೆಲ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀಟು ಸಿಗದೆ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದು ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ರೂ. 1,500 ರಂತೆ 10 ತಿಂಗಳು ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ವಸತಿ ಭತ್ಯೆ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a student resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Must be an active student
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you currently studying in a recognized post-matric course?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ಪಡೆದ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯೇ?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 2.5 Lakh
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your total annual family income?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಒಟ್ಟು ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ಎಷ್ಟು?

benefits_summary: Rs. 1,500 per month for 10 months (Total Rs. 15,000 per academic year).
application_process: Apply via Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in).
Enter SSP student ID, college details, and hostel non-availability status.
DBT credited directly to bank account upon verification.
source_title: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Financial assistance of Rs. 1500 per month for 10 months is provided to eligible students pursuing post-matric courses who could not get admission into departmental hostels.

name: Karnataka Anna Bhagya Scheme
department: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Govt of Karnataka
short_description: 10 kg food grains per person per month (5 kg food grains + cash equivalent of Rs. 170 per person) for BPL and Antyodaya families in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Anna Bhagya ensures food security for underprivileged families in Karnataka holding Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (BPL) ration cards, delivering 5 kg rice per person plus DBT direct cash transfer of Rs. 170 (at Rs. 34/kg for 5 kg) per beneficiary per month.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತ್ಯೋದಯ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ 10 ಕೆಜಿ ಆಹಾರ ಧಾನ್ಯ (ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಉಳಿದ 5 ಕೆಜಿಗೆ ನಗದು ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ) ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Karnataka Food & Civil Supplies Dept Notification 2023
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Must have BPL or Antyodaya Card
rules.source_citation: Anna Bhagya Scheme Rules, Clause 2 (BPL / AAY Cardholder)
rules.description_kannada: ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಅಂತ್ಯೋದಯ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿ ಹೊಂದಿರಬೇಕು
rules.clarification_question_en: Does your family hold a valid BPL or Antyodaya ration card?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬವು ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಅಂತ್ಯೋದಯ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿ ಹೊಂದಿದೆಯೇ?

benefits_summary: 5 kg free rice + DBT cash of Rs. 170 per person per month directly into bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar card of all family members
Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the head of family
application_process: Holders of valid BPL/AAY ration cards in Karnataka are automatically enrolled.
Collect rice from local Fair Price Shop (FPS) and receive monthly DBT for additional 5 kg directly in bank.
source_title: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Under Anna Bhagya guarantee scheme, 10 kg food grains are provided to every member of BPL and AAY ration card holder families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India
short_description: Financial assistance of Rs. 1.20 Lakh to Rs. 1.30 Lakh to rural homeless and families living in kutcha houses for pucca house construction.
detailed_description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all rural families who are homeless or living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, with unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 Lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 Lakh in hilly/difficult areas, alongside 90-95 days of unskilled wage labor under MGNREGS.
description_kannada: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾಗದ ಬಡ, ನಿರಾಶ್ರಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಮನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಕ್ಕಾ ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ರೂ. 1,20,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Rural Residence
rules.clarification_question_en: Do you live in a rural village area?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 1.5 Lakh
rules.source_citation: SECC 2011 Rural Deprivation Criteria for Housing
rules.description_kannada: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 1.5 ಲಕ್ಷ ಮೀರಬಾರದು
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your approximate annual family income?

benefits_summary: Financial grant of Rs. 1,20,000 for house construction + MGNREGA wages (~Rs. 25,000) + Rs. 12,000 for toilet under SBM.
required_documents: Document of land/site ownership or Gram Panchayat allotment
application_process: Beneficiary list is drawn from SECC/Awaas+ data and verified by Gram Sabha.
Registration is done by Panchayat Secretary via the AwaasSoft portal with geotagged photo of existing kutcha house.
source_title: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
source_excerpt: To achieve the objective of providing 'Housing for All' in rural areas, unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh is provided in plain areas.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
short_description: Comprehensive crop insurance with minimal farmer premium (1.5% to 2% for food crops, 5% for horticultural crops) covering natural disaster yield loss.
detailed_description: PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of unforeseen events such as drought, floods, pests, and unseasonal rainfall.
description_kannada: ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ವಿಕೋಪಗಳು, ಅನಾವೃಷ್ಟಿ, ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಅಥವಾ ಕೀಟಬಾಧೆಯಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆ ನಷ್ಟ ಉಂಟಾದಾಗ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಬೆಳೆ ವಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Must be Farmer
rules.source_citation: PMFBY Revised Operational Guidelines, Section 2 (Farmer Eligibility)
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a farmer cultivating notifying crops?

benefits_summary: Full sum insured payout against crop failure at a subsidized premium rate (max 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops).
benefits_amount: Full Sum Insured on Crop Loss
required_documents: Sowing certificate / Self-declaration of crop sown
application_process: Apply via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) or Karnataka Samrakshane portal (samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in).
Submit land survey number and crop details.
Pay the subsidized farmer premium online or at bank/CSC.
source_title: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
source_excerpt: PMFBY aims at supporting sustainable production in agriculture sector by way of providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
short_description: High-interest small savings scheme (current 8.2% p.a.) with tax exemption for girl children up to 10 years of age.
detailed_description: Under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, parents or legal guardians can open an SSY account for a girl child from her birth until she turns 10 years old. Deposits can be made for 15 years, maturing after 21 years with triple tax exemption (EEE).
description_kannada: ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಮದುವೆ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಪೋಷಕರು 10 ವರ್ಷದೊಳಗಿನ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಗುವಿನ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಚೆ ಕಚೇರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದ ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಖಾತೆ ತೆರೆಯುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Must be Girl Child
rules.clarification_question_en: Is the child for whom the account is being opened a girl?

rules.name: Age must be 10 years or below
rules.description_kannada: ಮಗುವಿನ ವಯಸ್ಸು 10 ವರ್ಷ ಅಥವಾ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಿರಬೇಕು
rules.clarification_question_en: What is the age of the girl child?

benefits_summary: 8.2% annual compounded interest, complete tax exemption under Sec 80C, partial withdrawal for higher education at age 18.
required_documents: Aadhaar / ID proof of parent or guardian
application_process: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Submit the SSY account opening form with the child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC.
Passbook is provided upon deposit.
source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Govt of India
source_excerpt: The account may be opened by one of the guardian in the name of a girl child, who has not attained the age of ten years as on the date of opening of the account.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
short_description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore for at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.
detailed_description: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading.
description_kannada: ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಜಾತಿ (SC), ಪರಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಪಂಗಡ (ST) ಅಥವಾ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಉದ್ಯಮ ಆರಂಭಿಸಲು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ರೂ. 10 ಲಕ್ಷದಿಂದ ರೂ. 1 ಕೋಟಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Minimum Age 18
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your current age in years?

benefits_summary: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between Rs. 10 Lakh and Rs. 1 Crore with margin money support.
benefits_amount: Loan: Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 1 Crore
required_documents: Proof of identity (Aadhaar / Passport / PAN Card)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for greenfield enterprise
Proof of business address and lease agreement
application_process: Apply online through the Stand-Up Mitra portal (standupmitra.in).
Choose whether you need handholding support or are ready to borrow.
Portal forwards application to preferred bank branch for appraisal.
source_title: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
source_excerpt: The objective of the Stand-Up India scheme is to facilitate bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe borrower and at least one woman borrower.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Govt of India
short_description: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per year (Rs. 1,000/month) for meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying from Class 9 to Class 12.
detailed_description: NMMSS awards 1,00,000 scholarships annually to meritorious students whose parents' annual income is not more than Rs. 3,50,000, to prevent dropout after Class 8 and encourage completion of secondary stage schooling up to Class 12.
description_kannada: ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ 8ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮೊಟಕುಗೊಳಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು 9ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಿಂದ 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿವರೆಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ರೂ. 12,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Must be a Student
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you currently studying in school?

rules.name: Family Income <= Rs. 3.5 Lakh
rules.clarification_question_en: Is your total parental annual income up to Rs. 3,50,000?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪೋಷಕರ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 3,50,000 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದೆಯೇ?

benefits_summary: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 12,000 per annum (Rs. 1,000 per month) for 4 years from Class 9 to Class 12.
required_documents: Class 7/8 Marksheet showing minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST)
application_process: Appear for the state-level NMMSS selection exam conducted by DSEL / KSEAB in Class 8.
Upon selection, register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with student OTR.
DBT credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account annually.
source_title: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
source_excerpt: Under this scheme, 100,000 scholarships are awarded to the gifted or meritorious students whose parental income is not more than Rs. 3,50,000/- per annum.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
department: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt of India
short_description: Financial scholarship for Class 9 and Class 10 minority students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) with family income <= Rs. 1 Lakh.
detailed_description: Provides financial assistance to students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 9 and 10 in government and government-aided schools, with at least 50% marks in the previous final examination and family income not exceeding Rs. 1.00 Lakh.
description_kannada: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದಿಂದ ಅಧಿಸೂಚಿತಗೊಂಡ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ 9 ಮತ್ತು 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.

rules.name: Must belong to Minority Community
rules.clarification_question_en: Do you belong to a notified religious minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi)?
